page.layout: One printed page, right-hand page of the opening, no columns and no marginal notes. Running head at top centre with the page number at top right. Running text from top to bottom, an italic line set apart, a centred heading, a second heading, and a gathering signature at the foot. The strip at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: la singulis licuisset sua insomnia & deliria tradere, sub fuco & specie veræ doctrinæ, quasi hæc à maioribus sic essent tradita. Nam cum illa fiant libris conscriptis & consignatis, quid futurum credendum est, si libri nulli extarent? Fuit igitur & nobis admodum utile, & Apostolis necessarium in explendo munere suo, scripto conservari & propagari veritatis historiam in Ecclesia.

p.i: Hactenus ea quæ ad Definitionem, seu Descriptionem librorum N. T. spectabant, sequitur

main_text.head: DISTRIBUTIO LIBRO-RUM. N. TESTAMENTI.

head.i: Librorum N. Testamenti alii sunt Histori-ci, alii Didactici seu doctrinales.

main_text.p: HISTORICOS vocamus in quibus rerum gestarum continetur quædam narratio historica: & quanquam in his quoque sunt multa didactica, tamen præcipuus scopus, & orationis filum narrationem habet historiæ gestæ, hinc libet historicos appellare.
Porrò ea narratio instituitur, vel de ipso Mes-sia exhibito; vel de ipsius Discipulis, & doctri-nae eius testibus.
Prioris generis sunt quatuor Evangelistae. Habent enim historiam de incarnatione, vitâ, do-ctrinâ, miraculis, ac moribus Filii Dei, mortem etiam & quæ mortem sint consecuta studiosè describunt.

page.notes: No marginal notes on this page. The page opens mid-sentence ("la singulis"), so the first paragraph is marked as a continuation. The last paragraph runs on to the next page. The signature "A. 5." is printed at the foot. Hyphenated line breaks are kept as printed ("Mes-sia", "doctri-nae", "Histori-ci", "do-ctrinâ"). The left-hand strip is the edge of the facing page and is excluded. The heading "Acta Apostolorum" is set in a larger italic and is treated as italic text.
